title: Generative AI education governance and evidence watchlist

sources.title: NIST AI RMF Generative AI Profile
invalidation_triggers: NIST publishes a replacement or education-specific profile
risk-management categories materially change for generative or agentic AI
sources.action_if_changed: Review service-BOM, evidence ladder, schema fields, and red-team defaults.

sources.title: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs and Gen AI Apps
invalidation_triggers: OWASP changes major risk classes or risk numbering
new excessive-agency, prompt-injection, data-exfiltration, or supply-chain risk affects school workflows
sources.action_if_changed: Revise SEC posture, abuse tests, service-record security fields, and stop triggers.

sources.title: OECD Digital Education Outlook 2026
invalidation_triggers: OECD publishes stronger evidence for learning gains or learning harms by use pattern
OECD changes guidance about purpose-built versus general-purpose AI use
sources.action_if_changed: Update cognitive-effort budgets, construct map defaults, and learning-claim expiry clocks.

sources.title: EEF ChatGPT in lesson preparation trial and EdTech evaluation agenda
invalidation_triggers: New independent evaluation changes workload or resource-quality claims
Evidence indicates hidden review burden offsets preparation-time savings
sources.action_if_changed: Revise CL-WORKLOAD evidence grades and public-summary claim limits for teacher-facing tools.

sources.title: U.S. Department of Education AI guidance surfaces
invalidation_triggers: Federal education guidance changes allowable AI uses or program conditions
Privacy, accessibility, civil-rights, or grant-funding conditions are clarified
sources.action_if_changed: Update sector adapters, stop rules, public-summary limits, and compliance claim expiry.

sources.title: Digital Promise AI in education evaluation guidance review
invalidation_triggers: state guidance moves from exploratory/piloting to systematic evidence expectations
state guidance names stronger local evaluation or reporting duties for K-12 AI pilots
sources.action_if_changed: Review first-sprint metrics, decision-delta requirements, and public-summary limits before broadening claims.

sources.title: FTC COPPA update and children privacy guidance
invalidation_triggers: COPPA guidance changes consent, retention, deletion, disclosure, or security expectations
children privacy guidance changes treatment of AI or machine-learning data uses
sources.action_if_changed: Update aggregate-only minor-facing packet defaults, retention/deletion notes, and prohibited-transfer fields.

sources.title: Mixed AI tutoring and learning-evidence signals
invalidation_triggers: new RCTs materially change the tutor evidence balance by design pattern or age band
evidence distinguishes custom pedagogical tutors from general answer bots more sharply
sources.action_if_changed: Revise hint-tutor learning-signal requirements, cognitive-effort safeguards, and claim-family evidence grades.

sources.title: EU AI Act education and vocational training high-risk categories
invalidation_triggers: EU guidance changes education high-risk interpretation or deployment obligations
Annex III education categories or timelines materially change
a proposed pilot crosses from course operations into admission, grading, assignment, or test monitoring
sources.action_if_changed: Review and update the education risk crosswalk, action-authority ceilings, construct map, and FT-0181 block rules.

sources.title: European Commission high-risk AI systems classification guidelines
invalidation_triggers: European Commission changes practical examples or classification guidance for high-risk systems
education examples clarify admissions, assignment, learning-outcome evaluation, education-level assessment, test monitoring, profiling, or deployer obligations
an FT-0181-like workflow adds tool action authority that resembles high-risk education classification
sources.action_if_changed: Review and update the education risk crosswalk, action-authority ceilings, construct map, and owner-reply block rules before any live-window decision.

sources.title: UNESCO guidance for generative AI in education and research
invalidation_triggers: UNESCO revises data privacy, age-appropriate, or human-agent design guidance
new guidance changes defaults for independent child interaction with GenAI platforms
sources.action_if_changed: Review and revise youth-safeguarding defaults, age/data boundaries, and the education risk crosswalk.

sources.title: NYC Public Schools guidance on artificial intelligence
invalidation_triggers: NYCPS changes privacy review, student-data, model-training, or adult-review requirements
district implementation controversy reveals a missing parent/stakeholder or opt-out boundary
sources.action_if_changed: Review and update data-boundary, human-review, stakeholder-notice, and service-record adapter defaults.

sources.title: CoSN student data privacy and edtech leadership signals
invalidation_triggers: CoSN reports a material change in district student-data privacy capacity or AI risk priorities
district privacy burden suggests the archive is asking for records schools cannot safely or realistically provide
sources.action_if_changed: Review and update privacy-burden assumptions, minimum packet fields, and evidence watchlist cadence.
